title: The Crooked Ember
author: N. M. Villalobos
blurb: Zephyrine Lockridge, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
